publishable_sections.title: Redaction Boundary
publishable_sections.body: The public page should show architecture, evidence, and high-level metrics while keeping private repo names, secrets, customer details, and local paths out.

publishable_sections.title: Honest Gaps
publishable_sections.body: Publish current limitations directly: deployed proof uses public-safe mock runtime credentials, and private asset details require local review.

redaction_policy: Summarize private repositories by count, layer, maturity, and score band only.
Do not publish private repo names, descriptions, URLs, local paths, secrets, customer data, or provider tokens.
Frame product proofs as examples; do not imply Nexural is the umbrella brand.
Publish gaps honestly, including non-production mock credentials or missing hosted proof when applicable.
remaining_gaps: sageideas.dev has not consumed this export in this commit because that repo currently has a large pre-existing dirty worktree.
